'''Anarchism''' is a [[political philosophy]] and [[Political movement|movement]] that is against all forms of [[authority]].
It seeks to abolish the institutions it claims maintain unnecessary [[coercion]] and [[hierarchy]], typically including the [[State (polity)|state]] and [[capitalism]].
== History == Anarchism has roots in the [[Age of Enlightenment]].
== See also == * [[Libertarianism]]
[[Category:Political movements]] [[Category:Anarchism]]

'''Autism''' is a [[Neurodevelopmental disorder|neurodevelopmental disorder]] characterized by difficulties with [[social interaction]] and [[communication]].
Parents often notice signs during the first three years of their child's life.<ref>Lord C, et al. (2018)</ref>
{{Infobox medical condition | name = Autism | field = Psychiatry }}
Autism is associated with a combination of [[Genetics|genetic]] and [[Environment (biophysical)|environmental]] factors.

'''Albedo''' is a measure of the [[Diffuse reflection|diffuse reflection]] of [[solar radiation]].
The [[albedo]] of fresh [[snow]] is high (0.80–0.90) while the albedo of the [[ocean]] surface is low. The average albedo of [[Earth]] is about 0.30.
